articles.title: Dai Nippon Printing (TSE:7912) Stock May Trade At A Discount On Earnings
articles.summary: Dai Nippon Printing has delivered a powerful 5 year share price run, and that kind of move naturally raises the question of whether today's valuation is still grounded in the company's earnings profile. With the stock now around ¥2,891.5 at the latest close, you need to ask what level of profit justifies paying that price. The share price has returned 123.5% over 5 years.
